analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read occurs when serializing cmsSigCrdInfoType: WriteCountAndString calls cmsMLUgetASCII on an untrusted cmsMLU loaded from profile data. The cmsMLU entry metadata (Len/StrW/entries) is not validated against the MLU mempool bounds, so _cmsMLUgetWide/cmsMLUgetASCII can return/read a wide-string pointer at/after the end of the allocated pool, causing the 2-byte read overflow seen in _cmsMLUgetWide (cmsnamed.c:346). Crash manifests in _cmsMLUgetWide, but root cause is unsafe use of malformed MLU data during write path in WriteCountAndString/Type_CrdInfo_Write.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_profile_fuzzer, attacker-controlled ICC bytes are opened as a profile, then cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag) and later cmsSaveProfileToFile are called. A crafted profile containing a CRDInfo/MLU structure with inconsistent entry offsets/lengths (e.g., PS sections nm/#0..#3 not actually backed by valid mempool data) is accepted, and during SaveTags -> Type_CrdInfo_Write -> WriteCountAndString, cmsMLUgetASCII reads past the MLU allocation. The PoC triggers this with malformed tag contents and then save operation.
